claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_on_hit_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items currently cannot compose a mastery-style on-hit rider alongside passive grants, so the Holy Avenger's fiend/undead hit rider has no honest host family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_target_creature_type_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The extra-damage rider is narrowed to a closed set of target creature types rather than applying on every hit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.magical_save_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The aura grants advantage only on saving throws against spells and other magical effects; the current surface cannot scope saving-throw advantage by cause.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: area_shape.class_level_threshold_radius
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The emanation radius scales by Paladin class level, but area attachments currently have fixed geometry only.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 feet.
